Title: Add full JSON Schema to all tool inputSchema definitions
Description: Every tool's inputSchema should be fully specified with types, required fields, enums for constrained values (e.g. focus: bugs|performance|security|readability|architecture), and min/max for numeric parameters. This enables IDE clients to generate UI for tool invocation, gives the server an early validation layer before hitting Ollama, and enables MCP client auto-validation. Currently many tools have incomplete schemas or rely only on FluentValidation runtime checks.
